consent_vote_body.message: Firefox now requires every extension to ask you before sharing any data. Allow it so RYD can count your likes, dislikes and comment reactions. This permission covers YouTube only, not other websites.

consent_account_body.message: Sign in to use account features, including your profile, notifications and Premium analytics.

consent_next_step.message: Select Allow in Firefox to review the permissions. You can decline.

consent_prompt_status.message: Choose whether to allow these permissions in Firefox.

consent_granted_status.message: Permissions are enabled. You can return to YouTube.

consent_declined_status.message: These optional features stay off. You can change permissions later.

consent_error_status.message: Permissions could not be updated. Please try again.

consent_details_summary.message: What do Firefox’s permission labels mean?

consent_details_intro.message: Firefox groups data into broad categories. Here is what each label means for RYD:

consent_browsing_body.message: Only the ID of the YouTube video you open, to load its dislikes and RYD comments. Never your browsing history or other websites.

consent_content_body.message: The like count shown on the YouTube video, to help improve dislike estimates.

consent_activity_body.message: Your likes, dislikes and RYD comment reactions on YouTube, so they count. Sent with a random ID that isn't linked to your Google or YouTube account.

consent_identity_body.message: Your profile information, such as a display name and email, only when you choose to sign in.

consent_auth_body.message: The authorization and session data needed to sign in and use account features.

consent_scope.message: RYD collects nothing outside youtube.com and does not access your YouTube account. It receives no name or email unless you sign in.

consent_settings.message: You can change these permissions at any time in Firefox’s add-on settings (about:addons).

consent_private_counts.message: Private windows show counts only, using the permission enabled in a regular window. Voting, sign-in, Premium analytics and discussions are unavailable there.

consent_voter_timing.message: Your voting ID is sent only when you vote or react. Your own comment reactions are remembered on this device.

popup_signin_next_click.message: One more click is needed: select your sign-in button below to review Firefox’s account permissions and continue.

changelog_firefox_vote_granted.message: Thank you. Your votes now count.

vote_consent_hint.message: Your vote isn't counted yet. Firefox now requires your permission before RYD can send it. This permission covers YouTube only, not other websites.

vote_not_counted.message: Your likes and dislikes aren't counted and won't show in dislike counts.

discussion_reactionConsentRequired.message: Turn on vote sharing to react to comments. Your reaction is sent once it's on.

counts_consent_toolbar.message: Open Return YouTube Dislike from Firefox’s extensions menu to continue.

counts_consent_declined.message: Counts stay off. You can enable them here later.

counts_consent_private.message: Enable dislike counts in a regular window first. Private windows show counts only.

data_consent_reason.message: Firefox now requires every extension to ask you before sharing any data. Allow RYD to show dislikes and count your votes. This permission covers YouTube only, not other websites.

data_consent_title.message: Show dislikes and make your votes count

data_consent_body.message: Firefox now requires every extension to ask you before sharing any data. It uses the same broad labels for every extension, so here’s what each one means for RYD:

data_consent_scope.message: RYD only works on YouTube. Allowing this doesn’t give it access to any other website.
